SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.phone, u.email, u.employee_no, u.status, u.create_time, u.update_time, u.create_user, u.update_user FROM sys_user u
AND u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.username}, '%')
AND u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.nickname}, '%')
AND u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.phone}, '%')
AND u.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.email}, '%')
AND u.employee_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.employeeNo}, '%')
AND u.status = #{query.status}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_dept ud INNER JOIN dept_closure dc ON ud.dept_id = dc.descendant_id INNER JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = dc.descendant_id AND d.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ud.user_id = u.id AND dc.ancestor_id = #{query.deptId} AND ud.status IN (1, 2) )
ORDER BY ${orderBySql}
